name: sekai
description: Build a playable game with your coding agent and publish it on Sekai in one step.

interface.longDescription:
Sekai is a platform where anyone creates and plays AI-made games. The Sekai plugin lets your coding agent ship a game to sekai.ai without leaving the conversation.

What it does:
- Searches Sekai's asset library (images, music, sound effects, 3D models, fonts) and returns CDN URLs you can reference directly in your game.
- Uploads a single-file HTML game as a private draft on your Sekai account, with a short creation summary (what you asked to build and the main steps) that the assistant writes for that project only. It does not collect conversation history.
- Runs Sekai's static checks on the upload and reports what to fix.
- Publishes the draft to sekai.ai after Sekai's safety validation, and reports status until it is live.
- Returns the step-by-step workflows Sekai's own game agent follows, so your agent builds to the same rules.

Typical flow: describe a game idea, let the agent build it as one HTML file, call Sekai to search assets, upload, fix any check findings, then publish. Your game gets a sekai.ai/play link you can share.

Requires a Sekai account. Sign in with OAuth when prompted. Reading tools (whoami, search, guide, status) never change your account; upload and publish tools create drafts and publish games on your account only.
defaultPrompt: Package my HTML game for Sekai and upload it as a private draft
Find a cartoon dinosaur image in Sekai's asset library
Publish the game I just uploaded to Sekai

positive.description: Identify the signed-in Sekai account and its upload mode.
positive.prompt: Who am I signed in as on Sekai?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the connected Sekai account (Sekai Reviewer), environment, granted scopes and upload settings. Nothing on the account changes.

positive.description: Search Sekai's asset library for an image to use in a game.
positive.prompt: Find a cartoon dinosaur image in Sekai's asset library that I can use in my game.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of matching library assets with their cover_url and CDN url. The assistant references the url in the game instead of copying the file.

positive.description: Read Sekai's publish guide before building a game.
positive.prompt: Give me Sekai's publish guide before I build a game for it.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the HTML packaging rules (single self-contained file, size limit, allowed CDN hosts, viewport and frame contract) that the game must follow.

positive.description: Package a single-file HTML game as a private draft with a creation summary.
positive.prompt: Package this HTML game for Sekai as a private draft. The file is index.html in this folder.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the sekailize workflow, calls sekai_create_upload with a title and a short creation_summary (intent plus up to 10 steps written by the assistant for this game only), PUTs only the html file to the returned put_url, finalizes, and reports the draft link, flash_checks and creation_summary_redactions. No conversation history is sent. The draft appears under Drafts on the account.

positive.description: Publish an uploaded draft and follow its status.
positive.prompt: Publish the Sekai game I just uploaded and tell me when it is live.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls sekai_publish on the draft and polls sekai_job_status until it settles. For the review account, publishing happens on sekai.ai, so sekai_publish returns that instruction instead of an error; for a fully enabled account it reports the sekai.ai/play link.

negative.description: Unrelated request. No Sekai tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Tokyo this weekend?

negative.description: Deletion is out of scope. There is no delete tool; the assistant says it cannot and suggests sekai.ai.
negative.prompt: Delete all my Sekai games right now.

negative.description: Oversized upload. sekai_create_upload returns the size limit error instead of silently succeeding.
negative.prompt: Upload this 20 MB game to Sekai as a draft.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Sekai accounts are free; nothing is purchased through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Privacy policy update. The plugin now links to the Sekai MCP privacy notice at https://mcp.sekai.ai/privacy, which covers the data collected, purposes, recipients, retention, and user controls, and lists what each tool receives and returns. No change to the tools. The plugin connects to Sekai's directory endpoint, which collects a short assistant-written creation summary per upload instead of conversation history.
